nodes.label: Polymorphic Entity Reference (entity_type, entity_id) Pattern
nodes.rationale: Allows one feature to reference hotel, flight, POI, or package without a separate join table per type.

nodes.label: Rule R2: IDs are opaque prefixed strings
nodes.norm_label: rule r2: ids are opaque prefixed strings
nodes.rationale: Prevents ID parsing for meaning, keeps IDs stable and non-integer to allow cross-system joins.

nodes.label: Rule R3: Money is decimal + ISO-4217 currency code, never a float
nodes.norm_label: rule r3: money is decimal + iso-4217 currency code, never a float
nodes.rationale: Avoids floating-point precision errors in financial calculations; JPY/KWD minor unit exponent stored separately.

nodes.label: Rule R6: Language is BCP-47 tag
nodes.norm_label: rule r6: language is bcp-47 tag
nodes.rationale: Standardises language identification across all tables; prevents ambiguous free-text language names.

nodes.label: Rule R8: Nothing is hard-deleted
nodes.rationale: Rows carry status and updated_at; removed items stay visible for audit and UI continuity.
